brand_voice._source: Derived from homepage H1, H3, key paragraphs, and the three 'NAV' differentiators

suggested._note: Scraped gave #4CAF50 green (confirmed brand from tank product color) + grey/charcoal nav chrome. Refined palette: deep forest green primary (luxe cleantech, not tech-SaaS green), kept #4CAF50 as accent (actual brand product color — the tanks and air pump are this green), added bright organic highlight, replaced default white with warm bone/sand for Nordic-cleantech feel. NOT corporate blue, NOT medical white, NOT dated Latvian home-improvement brown.

suggested.heading: Ubuntu
suggested._note: Ubuntu is the actual brand font (1395 uses, site-wide) — keeping it. Ubuntu has character (distinctive curved G, rounded geometric feel), not AI-slop-tier like Inter/Arial. For editorial display headlines added Fraunces pairing (warm serif with biological/organic curves — matches the 'bio' product story). Times New Roman was a footer/legal stub, ignored.
